name: Review Queue Processor
purpose: Drain review_queue.jsonl by adjudicating flagged items one at a time with a STRONGER local model via model.gateway (default tier mid = Qwen2.5-3B; strong = 27B). The queue has two producers (model.gateway, classify.batch). For each open item the reviewer consumes ONLY the distilled item (reason/requested/weak_result) plus a bounded fragment resolved from source_ref — never the whole batch — parses a small JSON verdict, and either resolves the item (fills resolution + status) or escalates it to the frontier (a status transition). Resolutions are written to the live queue in place (original flagging fields preserved) and to an append-only resolution log. First consumer/drainer of the review queue.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -QueuePath <file> (or -ReviewQueuePath alias); -MaxItems <int>; -FlaggedBy <model.gateway|classify.batch>; -Reason <s>; -Ids <array>; -Tier <tiny|weak|mid|strong> | -Model <model_id>; -GpuLayers <int> (tune the 27B) -LoadTimeoutSec <int> (raise for a cold strong-tier load); sampling -MaxTokens -Temperature -Seed; -EscalateThreshold <0..1>; -MaxFragmentChars <int>; -DryRun; -ResolutionLogPath <file>; plumbing -Registry -GatewayPath -PwshPath. OR -InputsJson '<json {queue_path,review_queue_path,max_items,flagged_by,reason,ids,tier,model,gpu_layers,load_timeout_s,max_tokens,temperature,seed,escalate_threshold,max_fragment_chars,dry_run,resolution_log_path,registry,gateway_path,pwsh_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: queue_path
inputs.description: Path to review_queue.jsonl (default: repo-root). -ReviewQueuePath is accepted as an alias.

inputs.name: max_items
inputs.description: Max open items to adjudicate in one pass (drains slowly in the background).

inputs.name: flagged_by
inputs.description: Only adjudicate items from this producer: model.gateway | classify.batch.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Only adjudicate items whose reason matches (low_confidence|contradiction|malformed|uncategorized|duplicate|needs_strong_review|failed_transform).

inputs.name: ids
inputs.description: Adjudicate only these review-item ids. Via InputsJson.

inputs.name: tier
inputs.description: Gateway LLM tier for the reviewer: tiny|weak|mid|strong. Default mid = Qwen2.5-3B (stronger than the weak producer). strong = 27B.

inputs.name: gpu_layers
inputs.description: Override the gateway's gpu_layers for this run — the knob to tune the 27B (strong) partial offload for 11 GB VRAM.

inputs.name: load_timeout_s
inputs.description: Override the gateway's server load timeout (default 120s). Raise it for a COLD strong-tier (27B) load, which reads ~16 GB from disk (~90s cold, ~8s warm).

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: RNG seed passed to the gateway for reproducibility.

inputs.name: escalate_threshold
inputs.description: Reviewer confidence below this (or an unparseable/uncertain verdict, or the model asking to escalate) sends the item to the frontier.

inputs.name: max_fragment_chars
inputs.description: Cap on the source fragment / previews shown to the reviewer, to keep adjudication cheap.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Adjudicate and report intended transitions but write NOTHING back (no queue rewrite, no log append).

inputs.name: resolution_log_path
inputs.description: Append-only resolution history log (default: review_resolved.jsonl beside the queue).

inputs.name: registry
inputs.description: Path to the gateway's models.json (passed through to model.gateway).

inputs.name: gateway_path
inputs.description: Path to Invoke-ModelGateway.ps1 (default: resolved from modules/07-model-gateway).

inputs.name: pwsh_path
inputs.description: pwsh executable used to spawn the gateway child (default the dotnet-tool pwsh).

outputs.description: { queue_path, dry_run, tier, reviewer_model, selected_from, escalate_threshold, selected_count, resolved_count, escalated_count, error_count, skipped_malformed, open_remaining, queue_written, items[ {id, flagged_by, reason, requested, kind, prior_status, new_status, verdict, decision, reviewer_confidence, model_self_confidence, escalated_to, finish_reason, source_fragment_resolved, error} ], resolution_log_path, resolution_count }

models: a stronger GGUF LLM via model.gateway (default the mid tier = Qwen2.5-3B; strong = 27B)
